messages:
lucy: Drafting release note for tonight's dedicated cluster tweak. Need ops + oncall to confirm rollout plan and rollback text. Target window: 23:30-01:30Z.

lucy: RN draft (short):
```
Change: pin dedicated EU-dedicated clusters to runtime:v2.3-quant.
Purpose: improved memory footprint and ~15% lower token cost for long sequences.
Canary: gradual traffic shift in EU-dedicated: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m steps. Total canary window: 90m.
Rollback: immediate rollback on sustained 5xx spike (envoy 5xx >0.8% for 10m) OR token_latency.p95 >30% above baseline for 5m.
Customer impact: no API change; behavior same aside from perf/cost.
```

deploy-bot: /deploy rollout runtime:v2.3-quant target=eu-dedicated canary-steps=5,25,50 step-interval=30m start=2026-03-28T23:30Z  queued. Preview: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1745559999

oncall-sre: Suggest replacing absolute % thresholds with relative where possible. Envoy 5xx is fine for alerting. Also add watch for model-serve mismatch logs: "kernel-mismatch" tag.

lucy: Good call. Updating RN to include kernel-mismatch log watch and clarify the envoy 5xx signal is primary.

product-mgr: Communicate to support that we may see transient latency fluctuations during step increases. Maybe add a short FAQ line in the RN.

comms: Timing check: if we push at 23:30Z we can send internal announce at 23:45Z and customer-facing note tomorrow morning. OK?

lucy: Yep. Internal announce 15m after first step sounds right. I'll add the paragraph for support FAQs.

ops-eng: On the pin: we should also pin the autoscaler policy to avoid aggressive scale-down during the canary. I'll paste the command to freeze scaling.

ops-eng: Freeze autoscaler snippet:
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch hpa runtime-service -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}' --type=merge
```

legal-bot: Quick check: runtime image is OSS-licensed dependency; distribution unchanged. No compliance blockers (auto-ack).

lucy: Rollback snippet for ops (short):
```bash
# revert traffic split and image
/ops traffic-split set eu-dedicated runtime:v2.3-quant=0 runtime:v2.2=100
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime-service runtime=image:redwood/runtime:v2.2
```

oncall-sre: I'll run the dashboard watchlist and post cadence updates every 10m during the canary. If we hit rollback criteria, I'll call the incident bridge and tag @eng-oncall.

product-mgr: One more ask: add a single-line blurb in RN that we won't do model re-quantization in this rollout, just runtime image change. Avoid confusion for model teams.

lucy: Added. Final RN link: https://docs.redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-eu-dedicated-v2.3-quant. Scheduling as planned. Will post internal announce once deploy-bot reports first step.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 2026-03-28T23:30:10Z  step=5% applied to eu-dedicated. Live monitor: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/eu-dedicated-rollout-1745559999

oncall-sre: First 10m warmup OK, no 5xx spike. Next step scheduled in ~20m. Will update. :eyes:
